pricing.rule: Pricing: all documentary versions free until the producer says a version is paid quality. v0.0.1 of each door is its native-language release (each language performed separately, no dubbing); earlier and dubbed cuts are v0.0.1-0.0.N (oldest lowest).
pricing.previous_rule: 29 Oct 2026: v0.0.1 free, each later version +£4.99 (suspended 30 Oct 2026: nothing is of paid quality yet)
pricing.sub_versions: Each door's earlier cuts are pre-releases numbered v0.0.1-0.0.1 (oldest), v0.0.1-0.0.2, ...; the entry's own 'version' names the cut that plays by default, its 'cuts' list the older ones, and 'next_version' a reserved version that is not yet playable. The page shows them as hashtag chips under each scene.
pricing.no_dubbing: 30 Oct 2026: no dubbing from now on. Each language gets its own separately performed video. A door's dubbed cuts stay playable as older versions (v0.0.1-0.0.N). Until a door's native-language performances exist, its newest cut plays under its sub-version and v0.0.1 is listed as coming (entry 'next_version').

filled.notes: 720p VP9; Welsh soundtrack with Welsh lip-sync: the 6 talking close-ups re-rendered 30 Oct 2026 with OmniHuman 2.0 on the Welsh lines, Nia and the Grandson turned three-quarters to talk to each other (never to camera); wide shots, document inserts and stills unchanged; English and Spanish dub tracks; cy/en/es subtitles. Document overlays cite EV-0195, EV-0198, EV-0200, EV-0210. Machine-assisted cy/es for native review.
filled.revision_note: v0.0.1 recut 30 Oct 2026: Welsh lip-sync on every talking shot (was English lip-sync with a Welsh dub).

filled.notes: 720p VP9, 18 shots, every shot moving: 11 OmniHuman 2.0 talking shots (speakers talk to each other, never to camera) and 7 image-to-video shots (Kling 2.5) plus end card. One video per language: the Welsh video is lip-synced to the Welsh track; the English and Spanish videos carry the same shots with the mouths re-synced to their own track (Kling LipSync). Two date cards: c. 200 BC and c. AD 200; the AD 200 farmer and wife are different people with different voices from the Iron Age couple. cy/en/es subtitles (Welsh and Spanish machine-assisted, for native review).
filled.revision_note: v1.0.0: former Scene 3 (c. AD 200 harvest) merged into Scene 2 as 'The hill before the records'; no narrator or archive bookend; out-of-period line about a round house and the barn removed; every still replaced by moving footage. v1.0.1 (30 Oct 2026): AD 200 farmer and wife recast as different people (4 talking shots + 1 harvest shot re-rendered). v1.0.2 (30 Oct 2026): the last two talking shots had the faces swapped (the wife's line lip-synced on the farmer and the farmer's on the wife, in every track) — fixed; the AD 200 couple re-voiced with voices not used in the Iron Age half (cy/en/es) and their 4 talking shots re-lip-synced; English and Spanish lip-synced videos added.

note: One entry per filled frame: {"n","clip","audio":{"cy","en","es"},"subs":{"cy","en","es"},"seconds","made","left_out":[event ids + reason]}. The page reads this file to open each door.
merge_note: 29 Oct 2026: Scene 3 merged into Scene 2 at the producer's word; door 3 is now the c. 650 monastic burial (script F004), not yet released.
video_note: An entry may carry 'video': {cy,en,es}: one video per spoken language, each lip-synced to its own audio track (and carrying only that track). When the listener picks an audio language, play video[lang] if present; otherwise play 'clip' with the separate audio[lang] track. 'clip' stays the Welsh video for back-compat.
paid_media_note: Paths beginning "doc:" are the newest (paid) cut of a scene. Those files are not in this repository; the documentary page streams them from the site's access service (/api/doc/media) with the scene's access code or an active membership.
